theorem mvcc.watchRecvOk_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (w : Loc) (rs : List mvcc.RespM) : Persistent
    (mvcc.watchRecvOk γ w rs)

theorem mvcc.respsIs_cons (v : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.WatchResponse) (rest : List
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.WatchResponse) (rs : List mvcc.RespM) : mvcc.respsIs (v
    :: rest) rs ⊢ ∃ r rs', ⌜rs = r :: rs'⌝ ∗ mvcc.respIs v r ∗ mvcc.respsIs rest rs'

def mvcc.watchRecvOk (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (w : Loc) (rs : List mvcc.RespM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γw r fcs L D d,
      mvcc.watcherMeta γ w γw ∗
        mvcc.watcherFixed w r fcs ∗
          ⌜mvcc.startLo r γw.lo⌝ ∗
            mvcc.evLog γ.st L ∗
              mvcc.relLb γ (List.length L) ∗
                (⌜(List.map Prod.fst D).flatten = mvcc.watchEvents L r γw.lo d⌝ ∨ mvcc.doomed γ γw.lo) ∗
                  ⌜List.map mvcc.RespM.evs rs = List.map Prod.snd (List.filter mvcc.Deliv.sent D) ∧
                        (d ≤ List.length L ∨ d ≤ γw.lo) ∧ ∀ (x : mvcc.RespM), x ∈ rs → x.w = w⌝ ∗
                    (□ ∀ dl, ⌜dl ∈ D⌝ -∗ ∃ fs, mvcc.filtersImpl fcs fs ∗ ⌜dl.snd = mvcc.filtered fs dl.fst⌝) ∗
                      □ ∀ x, ⌜x ∈ rs⌝ -∗ mvcc.respOk x)

theorem mvcc.watch_recv_au (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (ch : Loc) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (received : List

    mvcc.watchN (mvcc.watchChanInv γ ch γc) -∗ mvcc.watchConsumer γc received -∗ (∀ v ok,
    mvcc.watchRecvResult γ ch γc received v ok -∗ Φ v ok) -∗ recvAu γc.ch
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.WatchResponse Φ

theorem mvcc.prefix_drop_cons' {α : Type} {sent recv rs : List α} {r : α} (hp : recv <+: sent) (hd :
    List.drop recv.length sent = r :: rs) : recv ++ [r] <+: sent ∧ List.drop (recv ++ [r]).length
    sent = rs

theorem mvcc.chanWatcher_recvOk (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (closed : Bool) (sent
    : List mvcc.RespM) (w : Loc) (rs : List mvcc.RespM) (hrs : rs <+: List.filter (fun x => decide
    (x.w = w)) sent) : (mvcc.chanWatcher γ γc closed sent w ∗ □ [∗list] x ∈ sent, mvcc.respOk x) ⊢
    mvcc.chanWatcher γ γc closed sent w ∗ mvcc.watchRecvOk γ w rs

def mvcc.regsAt (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (k : Nat) (x : mvcc.RespM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ ps,
        (□ [∗list] p ∈ ps, mvcc.chanRegAt γc p.fst p.snd) -∗
          ⌜∀ (p : Loc × Nat), p ∈ ps → p.snd ≤ k⌝ -∗
            ⌜x.id = W64 (-1)⌝ -∗ £ 1 ={⊤}=∗ ⌜∀ (p : Loc × Nat), p ∈ ps → p.fst ∈ x.regs⌝)

theorem mvcc.chan_sent_snapshot_reg (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (ch : Loc) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (w :
    Loc) (n : Nat) : ⊢ £ 1 -∗ inv mvcc.watchN (mvcc.watchChanInv γ ch γc) -∗ mvcc.chanRegAt γc w n
    ={⊤}=∗ ∃ l, mvcc.chanSentLb γc l ∗ ⌜n ≤ l.length⌝

theorem mvcc.recv_cov (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (ch : Loc) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (sent : List
    mvcc.RespM) (L : List Loc) (received : List mvcc.RespM) (r : mvcc.RespM) (hp : received ++ [r]
    <+: sent) : inv mvcc.watchN (mvcc.watchChanInv γ ch γc) ∗ mvcc.sentAuth γ γc sent L ⊢
    mvcc.sentAuth γ γc sent L ∗ mvcc.respCov γ γc received r ∗ mvcc.regsAt γc received.length r ∗
    mvcc.chanSentLb γc (received ++ [r]) ∗ ⌜r.idx = received.length⌝

theorem mvcc.regsAt_persistent (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (k : Nat) (x : mvcc.RespM) : Persistent
    (mvcc.regsAt γc k x)

theorem mvcc.watch_tryrecv_au_alt (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (ch : Loc) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (received
    l0 : List mvcc.RespM) (n : Nat) (Φ : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.WatchResponse → Bool
    → IProp GF) (Ψ : IProp GF) (hcap : 0 < sint.Z γc.ch.chanCap) : ⊢ inv mvcc.watchN
    (mvcc.watchChanInv γ ch γc) -∗ mvcc.watchConsumer γc received -∗ mvcc.chanSentLb γc l0 -∗
    mvcc.api.wsSentLbI (mvcc.wsAbsOf γ ch γc) n -∗ (∀ v ok, mvcc.watchRecvResult γ ch γc received v
    ok -∗ Φ v ok) ∧ (mvcc.watchConsumer γc received -∗ ⌜l0 <+: received ∧ n ≤ received.length⌝ -∗
    mvcc.chanSentLb γc received -∗ Ψ) -∗ nonblockingRecvAuAlt γc.ch
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.WatchResponse Φ Ψ

theorem mvcc.delivs_prefix_cut (D : List mvcc.Deliv) (rs : List (List mvcc.EvM)) : rs <+: List.map
    Prod.snd (List.filter mvcc.Deliv.sent D) → ∃ k, k ≤ D.length ∧ rs = List.map Prod.snd
    (List.filter mvcc.Deliv.sent (List.take k D))

def mvcc.watchRecvResult (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (ch : Loc) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (received : List
    mvcc.RespM) (v : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.WatchResponse) (ok : Bool) : IProp GF :=
  if ok = true then
    iprop(∃ r,
        mvcc.watchConsumer γc (received ++ [r]) ∗
          mvcc.respIs v r ∗
            mvcc.respOk r ∗
              mvcc.apiRecvLb γ ch γc (received ++ [r]) ∗
                mvcc.watchRecvOk γ r.w (List.filter (fun x => decide (x.w = r.w)) (received ++ [r])) ∗
                  mvcc.chanRegFact γc r.w ∗
                    (⌜r.id = W64 (-1)⌝ → mvcc.progFact γc.prog) ∗
                      mvcc.respCov γ γc received r ∗
                        mvcc.regsAt γc received.length r ∗
                          mvcc.chanSentLb γc (received ++ [r]) ∗ ⌜r.idx = received.length⌝)
  else mvcc.watchConsumer γc received

theorem mvcc.watch_take (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (closed : Bool) (received sent
    : List mvcc.RespM) (L : List Loc) (v : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.WatchResponse)
    (rest : List go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.WatchResponse) (hpre : received <+: sent)
    (hsw : ∀ (x : mvcc.RespM), x ∈ sent → x.w ∈ L) : (ghostVar γc.recv (Qp.half 1) received ∗
    ghostVar γc.recv (Qp.half 1) received ∗ mvcc.respsIs (v :: rest) (List.drop received.length
    sent) ∗ (□ [∗list] x ∈ sent, mvcc.respOk x) ∗ (□ [∗list] w ∈ L, mvcc.chanRegFact γc w) ∗ (□
    [∗list] x ∈ sent, iprop(⌜x.id = W64 (-1)⌝ → mvcc.progFact γc.prog)) ∗ [∗list] w ∈ L,
    mvcc.chanWatcher γ γc closed sent w) ⊢ |==> ∃ r, ghostVar γc.recv (Qp.half 1) (received ++ [r])
    ∗ ghostVar γc.recv (Qp.half 1) (received ++ [r]) ∗ mvcc.respsIs rest (List.drop (received ++
    [r]).length sent) ∗ ⌜received ++ [r] <+: sent⌝ ∗ ([∗list] w ∈ L, mvcc.chanWatcher γ γc closed
    sent w) ∗ mvcc.respIs v r ∗ mvcc.respOk r ∗ mvcc.watchRecvOk γ r.w (List.filter (fun x => decide
    (x.w = r.w)) (received ++ [r])) ∗ mvcc.chanRegFact γc r.w ∗ (⌜r.id = W64 (-1)⌝ → mvcc.progFact
    γc.prog)
